name: Riftseeker’s Sanctum: Ritual Chambers
summary: Arcane halls where Riftseekers conduct planar rites, stabilize fractures, and channel Discord through ritual conduits.
description: The Ritual Chambers are the arcane heart of Riftseeker operations. Here, Riftseekers perform rites to stabilize planar fractures, bind Discord energy, and manipulate rift flows. The chambers are filled with ritual circles, arcane conduits, and crystalline foci that hum with unstable power. Muramite forces seek to disrupt these rites, hoping to collapse the Sanctum’s defenses. Discord manifestations erupt when rituals fail, turning the chambers into a volatile battleground of magic, instability, and planar resonance.
